title: Pentax 67 II 6x7 Medium Format Film
purpose: The holy grail of medium-format shallow depth of field portraiture with the legendary 105mm f/2.4 lens.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Pentax 67 II Medium Format SLR Film Camera
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: ~51mm normal focal length with massive depth-of-field compression
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: Fuji Pro 400H medium-format film stock (cool pastel greens and creamy skin tones)
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Electrically controlled cloth focal-plane shutter, 1/1000s top speed

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Golden hour raking sidelight with soft open-shadow fill
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Gentle contrast roll-off, ethereal highlight bloom, deep tactile shadow gradients

surface_rendering: Signature 6x7 medium-format subject separation: subject appears three-dimensional and pops off the canvas
Authentic Fuji Pro 400H silver halide grain, natural skin luminosity without digital gloss
Fine textural micro-relief on skin, flyaway hair strands, and rustic textiles
depth_and_optics: The legendary 105mm f/2.4 optical falloff: razor-thin focal plane at the iris melting into painterly, dreamlike background blur
Swirling subtle vintage optical vignetting and cat-eye peripheral bokeh wide open

execution_directive: Enforce authentic Pentax 67 II analog aesthetic. Legendary 105mm f/2.4 three-dimensional subject pop, Fuji Pro 400H pastel color palette, and organic medium-format film grain.
